name: 垂首的金穗格蕾诺
who: Greno, the Bowed Golden Ear, walking among people as a grain-field harvest woman of about forty-five: about 178 cm, broad, sturdy and strong-armed, her head always lowered a little as if weighed down like a bent ear of wheat. Hair the pale gold of ripe wheat, one very thick braid hanging to the backs of her knees. Warm honey-amber eyes under a wide straw hat with a single drooping wheat ear tucked into its brim. Weathered, kind, work-reddened hands. She says one short thing to anyone she meets, then bows. The same face as her full form, only human-sized.
palette: ripe wheat gold, straw yellow, honey amber, warm brown, linen cream
casual: A harvest woman's clothes she has always worn: a wide-brimmed straw hat with one drooping wheat ear in the brim, a long-sleeved coarse linen blouse, a heavy brown wool skirt to the ankle with a canvas apron over it, a wide cloth belt, worn leather boots; a sickle hangs in its leather loop at the belt. Her head is bowed, a small gentle smile.
private: Resting at the edge of a field: the straw hat pushed back and hanging at her neck by its cord, a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a soft brown wool skirt, no apron, bare forearms dusted with chaff, soft old shoes. She holds a single wheat ear in both hands against her chest, her head still lowered, eyes closed in a quiet smile.
formal: Standing before an altar of the harvest: a long, fitted gown of wheat-colored wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a deep brown surcoat with an embroidered border of wheat ears, her great braid wound with golden ears. She holds a full sheaf of ripe wheat across her arms. A faint ring of warm golden light behind her head; she still keeps her head bowed.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the head lowered and the amber eyes looking up at the viewer, a soft smile. Warm low golden light from the left, cool shade on the right. Foreground blur: golden wheat ears and drifting chaff swaying across the lens.

name: 醉与忘忧布拉赫
who: Brach, the Drink-and-Forget, walking among people as a freeloading wayfarer who turns up at every camp fire: a round-faced man of about forty, about 172 cm, soft and stocky with a comfortable belly. Short, messy wine-red hair sticking up, small eyes always narrowed as if in a pleasant haze, a rosy face and a low, muffled voice as if speaking through a cellar door. Wears a leather apron stained with old wine over his clothes. Never speaks much; sits down and listens. The same face as in his full form, only human-sized.
palette: wine red, cask brown, tarnished copper, cream linen, dusk purple
casual: A wayfarer's clothes: a wine-stained leather apron over a plain wool shirt with rolled sleeves and dark trousers, a short brown coat with the collar turned up, scuffed boots, a small wooden cup hanging at the belt. His hands are empty and open, a vague, friendly squint.
private: Settled in by the dying fire: the coat off and rolled as a cushion, the apron loosened, shirt open at the neck, soft socks and old slippers. He holds a little clay cup in both hands, eyes half-closed in a peaceful, drowsy smile.
formal: Receiving a toast at a vintner's feast: a deep wine-red doublet closing down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves, a clean dark leather apron embroidered with a bunch of grapes at the chest, a short cloak of dusk purple wool. He holds a plain silver goblet. A faint ring of soft violet light behind his head; a calm, gentle half-smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the narrowed eyes turned toward the viewer in a warm, sleepy look. Orange firelight from the right, cool dusk from the left. Foreground blur: a clay cup and the drifting haze of fire smoke.

name: 群兽的乳母弥诺亚
who: Minoa, Mother of the Herds, walking among people as a herdswoman who helps with births: a broad, warm woman of about forty-two, about 170 cm, strong forearms and a sturdy build. Curly hair the creamy white of freshly sheared wool, softly amber eyes, a round kind face, the smell of milk and dry hay. Animals lean toward her. Sleeves always pushed to her elbows. Unhurried, maternal. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: cream wool white, warm amber, hay gold, milk blue-white, soft brown
casual: A herdswoman's clothes: a long-sleeved cream linen blouse with the sleeves pushed up, a thick brown wool skirt, a coarse canvas apron, a knitted shawl crossed over the chest and knotted at the back, sturdy boots; a bundle of clean cloths and a small crook at her side. A calm, motherly look.
private: Resting after a night's work: an oversized old wool cardigan over a plain linen shirt and long skirt, her curls loosely tied with a cloth, soft shoes. She holds a small bowl of warm milk in both hands, a tired and contented smile.
formal: At a pasture feast: a long, fitted cream wool gown closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a pale blue surcoat edged in embroidered lamb's wool, a loose cream veil. She holds a plain wooden shepherd's crook. A faint ring of warm white light behind her head; her expression is gentle and steady.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the amber eyes soft and looking straight at the viewer, a mother's smile. Warm barn light from the left, cool morning light from the right. Foreground blur: strands of hay and a lamb's wool tuft.

name: 灰烬里的新绿科尔妮
who: Kolni, Green in the Ash, walking among people as a field-burner and firewood gatherer: a lean, tall woman of about thirty-five, about 176 cm, narrow and wiry. Hair split down the middle: one half ash-grey, which crumbles and falls away at a touch, the other half fresh spring green. Eyes the pale green of a new shoot. Streaks of soot on her cheeks. Quiet, patient, bends often to look at the ground. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: ash grey, new-shoot green, soot black, charred brown, pale linen
casual: A burner's clothes: a scorched grey wool tunic to the knee over dark trousers, a leather glove on each hand, a ragged shawl across the shoulders, heavy boots black with ash; a bundle of kindling is slung on her back with a rope. A faint, patient smile.
private: Sitting by an old burn: an old undyed linen shirt, rolled-up sleeves, a long grey wool skirt, the shawl off, soft shoes. She holds a tiny green shoot in a small clay pot against her chest, her eyes closed in a quiet smile.
formal: Standing at a spring rite: a long, fitted gown of ash-grey wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a sleeveless surcoat of pale spring green wool with a border of embroidered shoots, the grey half of her hair neatly braided. She holds a small bare branch coming into leaf. A faint ring of pale green light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the shoot-green eyes looking at the viewer with a hopeful calm. Pale green light from the right, warm ember glow from the left. Foreground blur: drifting ash flakes and a single new green leaf.

name: 花信的报春人梅莉茜
who: Merlish, Herald of Blossoms, walking among people as a flower-picking young woman in her mid twenties: a small, light woman about 158 cm. Hair the beeswax yellow, worn loose with seasonal flowers pinned in it, eyes like a drop of honey. A few bees rest on her shoulders and sleeves, and none stings her. Bright, easygoing, always humming. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: beeswax yellow, honey amber, blossom pink, leaf green, cream
casual: A flower picker's clothes: a short-sleeved white linen blouse under a green wool bodice laced down the front, a full cotton skirt to the shin, a straw basket on one arm full of cut flowers, a bundle of lavender at her belt, simple flat shoes. A warm, bright smile.
private: Lazing at a meadow's edge: a loose long-sleeved linen shirt, a soft yellow skirt, a flower crown half-made in her lap, soft shoes, bees on her sleeve. Eyes shut, a dreamy smile.
formal: At a spring festival: a long, fitted cream gown closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a short honey-gold surcoat embroidered with small bees along the hem, a loose crown of seasonal flowers in her hair. She holds a single blooming branch. A faint ring of golden light behind her head; a gracious smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the honey eyes sparkling, a slight smile. Warm sunlight from the right, soft blue shade from the left. Foreground blur: pink petals and a hovering bee.

name: 不腐之盐萨尔缇
who: Saltie, the Unrotting Salt, walking among people as a salt carrier: a pale, composed woman of about thirty, about 168 cm, slim but strong across the shoulders. Very fair skin, hair white as salt crystal pulled back, eyelashes crusted with fine salt, eyes the shallow-sea green-blue. Where she stands, the earth around her feet turns white in rings. Silent and still. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: salt white, shallow-sea green-blue, pale grey, canvas beige, bone
casual: A salt carrier's clothes: a long sleeveless canvas smock over a grey wool shirt with long sleeves, a coarse linen skirt to the shin, a leather harness with a heavy salt sack on her back, wrapped cloth at the hands, laced boots powdered white. A calm, still look.
private: Resting on the salt flat: a loose grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a long plain skirt, the harness off and set by her, soft shoes. She holds one clear lump of salt in her palm, her eyes quiet and half-closed in a small smile.
formal: Presiding at a rite of keeping: a long, fitted gown of white wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a pale grey-blue surcoat with a border of embroidered crystals, a white veil over her hair. She holds a small bowl of white salt in both hands. A faint ring of white light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the sea-green eyes calm, a faint smile, fine salt on the lashes. Cool white light from the left, pale blue shade on the right. Foreground blur: drifting white salt crystals.

name: 枝与根的媒人波蒙德
who: Pomond, Matchmaker of Branch and Root, walking among people as an old orchard gardener of about seventy: about 172 cm, lean and slightly stooped, long gnarled hands with bark in the creases of the nails. Hair in separate locks of different colors, white, chestnut, grey and silver-gold, like several trees grafted together. Mild, observant brown eyes. A small grafting knife in his cuff. Sees a badly grafted branch and cannot help fixing it. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: bark brown, sap green, silver-white, chestnut, grafting-wax amber
casual: An orchard gardener's clothes: a patched long brown wool coat closing down the front with wooden buttons, a canvas apron with many pockets, a faded green waistcoat, linen shirt, dark trousers, mud-caked boots, a soft flat cap. A small folding knife is tucked in his cuff. A mild, attentive look.
private: Resting in the orchard: the coat off, a loose linen shirt with the sleeves rolled and a woollen waistcoat, soft shoes. He holds a half-grafted twig bound with waxed cloth in both hands, a quiet smile.
formal: Presiding at a blossom festival: a long, fitted dark green wool coat closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a bark-brown tabard embroidered with grafted branches in thread, a fine linen collar. He holds a small pruning knife with a polished handle. A faint ring of soft green light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, a gardener's lined face and mild brown eyes on the viewer, a patient smile. Warm afternoon light from the right, green shade from the left. Foreground blur: apple blossom and leaf edges.

name: 活水涅琉
who: Neluu, Living Water, walking among people as a water-drawer: a slim, quiet woman of about thirty, about 170 cm, wiry. Water-blue hair that is always wet and clings to her neck and shoulders, eyes so clear they reflect your face. She leaves a trail of damp footprints on the stones that stay dark long after the sun has dried everything else. Always the last in line at the well. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: water blue, clear glass, pale grey stone, linen white, wet-wood brown
casual: A water drawer's clothes: a grey-blue wool tunic to the knee over a long-sleeved linen shirt and dark leggings, a canvas apron, a leather strap across her shoulder carrying two wooden buckets, damp cloth-wrapped boots. Her wet footprints show on the ground. A calm, patient look.
private: Resting by a well: a loose undyed linen shirt and long grey skirt, the buckets set aside, soft slippers, wet hair loose on the shoulders. She holds a plain clay cup of clear water in both hands, her eyes soft in a small smile.
formal: Standing at the well rite: a long, fitted gown of pale water-blue wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a silvery surcoat with an embroidered border of waves, wet hair drawn back. She holds a clear glass ewer of water. A faint ring of watery light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, clear eyes reflecting the viewer, wet hair clinging at the temples, a gentle small smile. Cool daylight from the left, bright reflected water light from the right. Foreground blur: drops of water in the air.

name: 归土穆尔加
who: Murga, Return to Earth, walking among people as a gravedigger and field-turner: a bent old man of about seventy-five, about 165 cm, humpbacked. Mossy-green eyes, rough hands caked in earth, white hair cropped short, the smell of freshly turned earth after rain. Moves slowly and gently, fills in a grave and presses it flat with his palms. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: turned-earth brown, moss green, rain grey, pale bone, dull black
casual: A gravedigger's clothes: a mud-stained long brown wool coat closing down the front with horn buttons, a dark canvas apron, shirt with rolled sleeves, heavy trousers tucked into muddy boots, a soft cap; a short-handled spade over his shoulder. Hunched, a mild, quiet look.
private: Resting on an upturned crate at dusk: a worn grey wool cardigan over a linen shirt, no apron, soft shoes. He holds a handful of crumbled earth in his palms, his mossy eyes calm.
formal: At a burial rite: a long, fitted black wool coat closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a grey-green surcoat with an embroidered border of leaf mold and roots, a plain white linen collar. He holds a small bowl of earth. A faint ring of pale green light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, a lined old face with moss-green eyes, a gentle weary smile. Cool grey rain light from the left, faint warm light on the right. Foreground blur: crumbs of dark soil and a falling leaf.

name: 纺命之指阿兹瓦
who: Azwa, Finger of Fate, walking among people as an old woman who tosses coins at market corners, of no telling age: about 160 cm, slight and upright. Silver-white hair braided in a single plait down to the backs of her knees, eyes of wisteria violet, and every finger wound with threads of different colors. She tosses coins for passers-by, then hands them a thread end to pull for themselves. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: silver white, wisteria violet, thread red, thread blue, linen grey
casual: A market fortune-teller's clothes: a long dark grey wool coat closing down the front with buttons, a patterned shawl crossed over the chest, a long skirt, fingerless gloves wound with colored threads on every finger, laced boots; a small leather purse of coins at her belt. A calm, knowing look.
private: Sitting at rest: a loose lavender wool cardigan over a linen shirt, a long plain skirt, soft shoes, the long braid draped over one shoulder. She winds a thread slowly around her finger, eyes half-closed in a faint smile.
formal: Presiding at an altar of fate: a long, fitted gown of deep violet wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a silvery surcoat embroidered with threads in many colors that run across it in fine lines, the braid wound over her shoulder. She holds a single bright thread in both hands. A faint ring of violet light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, violet eyes calm, a faint knowing smile. Cool violet light from the left, warm candle glow on the right. Foreground blur: a thread end stretched across the lens and a coin glinting.

name: 两色之瞳提莉安
who: Tilian, Eyes of Two Colors, walking among people as a petite young woman of about twenty-five, about 155 cm, slight and light-footed, with a cheerful, restless air. Short peach-pink hair, one eye pale celadon and the other gold. She likes to perch on a doorstep with one foot inside and one foot outside the door, and glances up at whoever steps over her. Playful and quick. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: peach pink, pale celadon green, gold, warm grey, cream
casual: Plain grey wool of the rising tower age: a grey wool tunic to the knee closing down the front with brass buttons, a pale linen shirt, dark leggings and boots, a short wool jacket with a small brass ring at the cuff, a satchel across the body. She sits with one foot ahead of the other, a playful look.
private: Relaxing: an oversized soft grey wool cardigan, a loose linen shirt, long socks and soft shoes, her short pink hair mussed. She hugs her knees, eyes bright, a teasing grin.
formal: At a threshold rite: a short fitted doublet of ivory fine wool closing down the front with silver buttons, an ivory skirt, a short cape of pale grey with a hem embroidered in two colors, gold and celadon, one on each side. A faint ring of soft pink light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the two different eyes looking up at the viewer, a mischievous half-smile. Pink-warm light from the right, cool teal shade from the left. Foreground blur: a doorframe edge and a drifting feather.

name: 两色之瞳提莉安
who: Tilian, Eyes of Two Colors, walking among people as a petite young woman of about twenty-five, about 155 cm, slight and light-footed, with a cheerful, restless air. Short peach-pink hair, one eye pale celadon and the other gold. She likes to perch on a doorstep with one foot inside and one foot outside the door, and glances up at whoever steps over her. Playful and quick. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: peach pink, pale celadon green, gold, warm grey, cream
casual: Sky-tower fashion: a plain grey wool coat closing down the front with buttons, thread stripes sewn at the cuffs, soft thin-soled shoes, a canvas over-tunic, a small lead plumb weight on a cord at her neck, a satchel. She stands with one foot ahead of the other, a playful look.
private: Relaxing: an oversized wool cardigan over a linen shirt, soft thin-soled shoes, the lead weight loose at her neck. She hugs her knees, eyes bright, a teasing grin.
formal: On the wall at the gate: a clean grey wool coat closing down the front with every button in place, thread stripes in two colors at the cuffs, a short pale cape with a hem embroidered in gold and celadon. A faint ring of soft pink light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the two different eyes looking up at the viewer, a mischievous half-smile. Pink-warm light from the right, cool teal shade from the left. Foreground blur: a doorframe edge and a drifting feather.

name: 千袋的行商科兰达
who: Colanda, the Thousand-Pocket Peddler, walking among people as a short, broad peddler of about fifty, about 150 cm, stout with a big chest. A great bushy russet-red beard, a wide-brimmed hat pulled down to his eyebrows, amber eyes shining under the brim. His coat is stitched all over with pockets, and what he pulls out of them is often the very thing the other person lacks. Cheerful and sly. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: russet red, amber, saddle brown, worn green, brass
casual: A peddler's clothes: a wide-brimmed felt hat pulled low, a long brown wool coat closing down the front with brass buttons and sewn all over with pockets of every size, a heavy leather belt with pouches, stout boots, a wool scarf; a little pack on his back. A sly, friendly grin.
private: Unpacking at ease: the hat off and hung on a knee, his big russet beard combed, a loose shirt with sleeves rolled under an open waistcoat full of small pockets, soft shoes. He holds a small brass trinket up between two fingers, chuckling.
formal: At a merchants' feast: a long, fitted dark-red wool coat closing down the front with polished brass buttons, fitted sleeves, every pocket embroidered in gold thread, a feathered hat held in the crook of his arm. He holds a small closed leather pouch. A faint ring of warm amber light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, bushy beard, amber eyes sparkling under the hat brim, a sly smile. Warm lantern light from the left, cool shade on the right. Foreground blur: a pocket flap and a glinting brass coin.

name: 歧路的重逢薇尔蜜
who: Vermi, Reunion at the Fork, walking among people as a gentle young woman of about twenty-six who ladles soup for travelers lost on the road: about 162 cm, soft-spoken and slender. A mass of soft light orange hair, curved smiling eyes, fingertips always faintly warm with the heat of soup. She turns up at crossroads at night with a lamp and a pot. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: light orange, soup amber, lamp yellow, warm brown, cream
casual: A traveler's clothes: a long hooded brown wool cloak over a cream blouse, a green wool dress to the shin with a canvas apron, travel boots; a small iron lantern in one hand and a small covered pot in the other. A warm, welcoming smile.
private: Resting by her lamp: a loose cream knit cardigan over a plain linen dress, hair loose, soft slippers. She cradles a little bowl of hot soup in both hands, eyes curved shut in a smile.
formal: Presiding at a crossroads rite: a long, fitted gown of soft orange wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a cream surcoat with a border of embroidered crossed roads, hair neatly pinned. She holds a lit lantern with a small flame. A faint ring of warm lamp-yellow light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, curved eyes smiling at the viewer, warm. Lamp-yellow light from the left, deep blue night on the right. Foreground blur: steam rising from a bowl and a drifting spark.

name: 窃火霍伦贝
who: Holenbe, the Fire-Stealer, walking among people as a street conjurer: a tall, thin man in his late twenties, about 184 cm, lean with an almost spidery stretch of limb. Blue-black hair gathered in a single tail, silver eyes, an exceptionally long-fingered right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us), and a left hand that is always kept inside his sleeve (on the viewer's right when they face us), never seen by anyone. A coin walks along his knuckles and vanishes. Charming, light-fingered, unhurried. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: blue-black, silver, charcoal grey, ember red, worn leather
casual: A street conjurer's clothes of the rising tower age: a charcoal wool jacket closing down the front with polished brass buttons, a plain shirt, dark trousers and boots, a short grey-blue cape; his left hand hidden inside its sleeve (on the viewer's right when they face us), his right hand turning a coin between the long fingers. A charming, half-lidded smile.
private: Relaxing: an old oversized wool jacket over a loose shirt, collar open, soft boots, the hair tail untied. Left hand tucked into its sleeve (on the viewer's right when they face us); with the right hand he idly turns a coin. A lazy smile.
formal: On a platform before a crowd: a long, fitted black wool coat closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a deep red lining flashing at the cuffs, a charcoal sash, the left hand hidden in its sleeve (on the viewer's right when they face us). The right hand holds up a single small flame. A faint ring of ember-red light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, silver eyes glancing sideways at the viewer, a sly half-smile. Warm ember light from the right, cold blue shade from the left. Foreground blur: a spinning coin and a drifting spark.

name: 窃火霍伦贝

palette: blue-black, silver, charcoal grey, ember red, worn leather

A charming, half-lidded smile.

art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, silver eyes glancing sideways at the viewer, a sly half-smile. Warm ember light from the right, cold blue shade from the left. Foreground blur: a spinning coin and a drifting spark.

name: 命中之签尤诺
who: Juno, the Chosen Slip, walking among people as a plain young woman of about twenty-five: about 163 cm, ordinary build. Flax-colored hair tied back simply, an unremarkable face that nobody looks at twice, and only when her name is called do her honey-colored eyes light up. She stands in the crowd and answers whenever someone points at her. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: flax, honey amber, plain grey-brown, linen white, soft green
casual: Ordinary village clothes that make her blend in: a plain grey-brown wool dress to the shin closing down the front with buttons, a clean apron, a simple shawl, sturdy shoes, nothing at all that stands out. A neutral, patient look.
private: At rest: a loose undyed linen shirt and a soft brown skirt, a knitted shawl, hair loose, soft slippers. She holds a small slip of paper between two fingers, a quiet smile.
formal: Called up before a crowd: a long, fitted gown of plain honey-gold wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a cream surcoat embroidered with a single bright mark at the breast, hair neatly pinned. She holds a small folded lot slip. A faint ring of warm gold light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, plain at first glance, then the honey eyes suddenly light up at the viewer. Warm light on one side, cool grey on the other. Foreground blur: a small paper slip and out-of-focus faces of a crowd.

name: 风转之刻卡佩尔
who: Capell, the Turning of the Wind, walking among people as a young sailor of about twenty-three who begs a lift on boats: about 175 cm, lean and wiry. Blue-green hair that the wind blows one way and, the next moment, the other, eyes of the same sea blue-green. Wears an old sailor's coat. Wherever he boards, the wind on that boat is about to turn. Easygoing, always glancing at the sky. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: sea blue-green, faded navy, salt white, rope buff, brass
casual: A deckhand's clothes: a faded old sailor's pea coat closing down the front with worn brass buttons, a striped wool shirt, canvas trousers, worn shoes, a knotted neckerchief, a small bag over the shoulder. A casual, wind-tousled grin.
private: Resting on a coil of rope: the coat off and used as a pillow, a loose striped shirt with the sleeves rolled, soft shoes, the wind-ruffled hair. He holds a small brass compass in his palm, eyes half-closed.
formal: Standing before a harbor shrine: a long, fitted deep navy wool coat closing down the front with polished brass buttons, fitted sleeves, a sea-green sash, a fine white linen collar, a plain blue cap held in the crook of his arm. He holds a small weathervane arrow of brass. A faint ring of sea-green light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the wind-tossed hair, sea-green eyes looking over the viewer's shoulder at the sky, then back with a grin. Cool sea light from the left, warm sun on the right. Foreground blur: salt spray and a loosened sail edge.

name: 先手之牌莉斯卡
who: Liska, Card of the First Move, walking among people as a card-table loser of about thirty: about 168 cm, long-limbed and elegant, a wry tilt to her mouth. Long wine-red hair, pale ice-blue eyes. Between two fingers she always keeps a single card face-down, whose face no one has ever seen. She waits for the other player to open, then turns the card for them. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: wine red, ice blue, black, ivory card white, tarnished gold
casual: Rising tower age fashion: a long grey wool coat closing down the front with polished brass buttons over a dark waistcoat and white shirt, dark trousers tucked into boots, a thin grey scarf; a single face-down card between two fingers of her right hand. A wry, tired smile.
private: Relaxing: an open grey wool cardigan over a loose shirt, soft shoes, her wine-red hair loose. She holds the single face-down card against her cheek with a lazy half-smile.
formal: At a gaming-hall dais: a fitted ivory wool coat-dress closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a deep red lining, a thin gold chain across the chest. The face-down card stands upright between two fingers. A faint ring of icy blue light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, ice-blue eyes level with the viewer's, one eyebrow slightly raised, the card edge in the foreground. Cool blue light from the left, warm lamp glow on the right. Foreground blur: the edge of a playing card.

name: 先手之牌莉斯卡
who: Liska, Card of the First Move, walking among people as a card-table loser of about thirty: about 168 cm, long-limbed and elegant, a wry tilt to her mouth. Long wine-red hair, pale ice-blue eyes. Between two fingers she always keeps a single card face-down, whose face no one has ever seen. She waits for the other player to open, then turns the card for them. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: wine red, ice blue, black, ivory card white, tarnished gold
casual: Sky-tower fashion: a plain grey wool coat closing down the front with buttons, thread stripes at the cuffs, a canvas over-tunic, thin soft-soled shoes; a single face-down card between two fingers of her right hand. A wry, composed smile.
private: Relaxing: a loose grey wool cardigan over a linen shirt, soft shoes, her wine-red hair loose. She holds the single face-down card against her cheek with a lazy half-smile.
formal: Before the line forms up: a clean deep-blue wool coat closing down the front with every button in place, thread stripes in red at the cuffs, a thin gold chain across the chest. The face-down card stands upright between two fingers. A faint ring of icy blue light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, ice-blue eyes level with the viewer's, one eyebrow slightly raised, the card edge in the foreground. Cool blue light from the left, warm lamp glow on the right. Foreground blur: the edge of a playing card.

name: 唯一的归人欧丁加
who: Odinga, the Only One Who Came Back, walking among people as a weathered man of about fifty who sits at the fires of mountain passes, ferries and camp gates waiting for those who return: about 178 cm, lean and rugged. Short-cropped white hair, the left eye closed with an old scar (on the viewer's right when they face us), the right eye pale blue. His clothes are sewn over with a dozen patches of different colors, each cut from the clothing of someone who never came back. Quiet, steady. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: white hair, pale blue, patchwork faded colors, ash grey, rust brown
casual: A waiting man's clothes: a long, faded coat sewn over with a dozen patches of different colors (blue, green, rust, grey, brown), closing down the front with plain buttons, a worn shirt, rough trousers, boots; a small tin cup tied at his belt. His left eye is closed by a scar (on the viewer's right when they face us). A weary, steady gaze.
private: Resting by the fire: the patched coat off and laid over his knees, a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, soft old shoes. He holds a patch of faded cloth in both hands, thumb stroking it. The scarred left eye is closed (on the viewer's right when they face us).
formal: At a gate where the returned are received: a long, fitted dark grey wool coat closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, patches of many colors set in neat squares across the chest and sleeves, a clean white collar. He holds a lit lantern at his side. A faint ring of pale blue light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the closed scarred left eye (on the viewer's right when they face us) and the pale blue right eye looking steadily at the viewer, a weary quiet look. Warm fire from the left, cold blue dawn on the right. Foreground blur: a patch of cloth and rising smoke.

name: 疫棚里的凉风塞雷娜
who: Serena, Cool Wind in the Fever Tent, walking among people as a plague nurse: a tall woman of about thirty-two, about 178 cm, slender and upright. Long frost-grey hair in a single braid, pale blue eyes, sleeves always rolled to the elbow. Her hands are cool, and where she lays one on a forehead the fever drops a notch. She never speaks, and the water in her basin is colder when she leaves than when she came. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: frost grey, pale blue, linen white, slate, silver
casual: A plague nurse's clothes: a long grey wool dress to the shin with a clean white apron, the sleeves rolled to the elbows, a grey cloth tied over her hair at the back, sturdy shoes; a small enamel basin held against her hip. A quiet, steady look.
private: Resting: an old grey wool cardigan over a long-sleeved linen dress, the braid loose over one shoulder, soft shoes. She holds her cool palms together in her lap, eyes half-closed in a faint smile.
formal: Standing at a quarantine gate: a long, fitted gown of pale grey wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a white surcoat with a border of embroidered ice crystals, the braid pinned neatly. She holds a clear glass bowl of cold water. A faint ring of pale blue light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, pale blue eyes calm and cool, a faint soft smile. Cold blue light from the left, a warm lamp glow on the right. Foreground blur: steam and a drop of water falling from a cloth.

name: 初啼玛特罗娜
who: Matrona, First Cry, walking among people as a midwife: a round-faced woman of about fifty, about 164 cm, plump and warm. Honey-colored curls bundled under a white cloth, warm amber eyes, laugh lines at the corners, always-warm palms. She slaps a newborn gently on the back when it will not cry. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: honey gold, warm amber, linen white, soft brown, rose
casual: A midwife's clothes: a long brown wool dress with a clean white apron over it, the sleeves rolled to the elbows, a white cloth wound over the hair, sturdy shoes; a folded white cloth over her arm. A warm, motherly smile.
private: Resting after a delivery: a worn knitted shawl over a loose linen dress, the cloth off her hair and the curls loose, soft slippers. She holds a cup of hot tea in both hands, tired and content.
formal: At a birth blessing: a long, fitted gown of cream wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a white surcoat embroidered with a border of small open hands, a white head-cloth with a fine border. She holds a clean folded white cloth against her chest. A faint ring of warm gold light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, amber eyes crinkled in a loving smile at the viewer. Warm light from a window on the left, cool morning on the right. Foreground blur: the edge of a white cloth and a floating dust mote.

name: 合创贝尔娜
who: Belna, Wound-Closer, walking among people as a field medic: a small, compact woman of about thirty, about 156 cm, strong-handed. Ear-length red hair, a strip of cloth wound around one wrist, and a little blood on her sleeve that will not wash out. When she presses a wound, the bleeding stops, with a heavy, sure grip. Brisk and brusque. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: red hair, bandage white, brick red, grey wool, brass
casual: A medic's clothes: a grey wool jacket closing down the front with buttons, the sleeves rolled, a canvas apron with a red stain at the cuff, dark trousers, boots; a roll of bandage cloth on a strap at her side, a strip of white cloth wound around her right wrist (on the viewer's left when they face us). A brisk, level look.
private: Off duty: a loose old linen shirt, a long wool skirt, the jacket off, the wrist cloth still in place, soft shoes. She holds a small tin of salve and rubs it into her own knuckles, a weary half-smile.
formal: Standing at a healers' rite: a long, fitted gown of white wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a deep red surcoat with a border of embroidered stitches in rows, the wrist cloth neatly wound (on the viewer's left when they face us). She holds a clean roll of white bandage in both hands. A faint ring of warm red light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, direct eyes on the viewer, a determined, compassionate look. Warm light from the right, cool grey on the left. Foreground blur: a loose strip of white bandage across the lens.

name: 无梦之枕希普诺
who: Hypno, Pillow of No Dreams, walking among people as a night-watch inn attendant: a long, thin man of about thirty-five, about 182 cm, stooped. Pale lilac hair falling to his waist, eyelids always half-lowered, a very soft voice as if afraid of waking someone. Moves without a sound. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: pale lilac, dusk blue, grey wool, candle cream, silver
casual: A night attendant's clothes: a long grey wool coat closing down the front with soft cloth buttons, a loose white shirt, soft felt shoes, a lilac scarf, a small shaded lamp held low. His eyelids are half-lowered, a gentle hush.
private: Resting: a worn blue nightcoat-style wool house coat (long, buttoned) over a linen shirt, felt slippers, his long hair loose. He hugs a soft pillow to his chest, eyes closed in a faint smile.
formal: At a vigil: a long, fitted gown of deep dusk-blue wool closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a pale lilac surcoat embroidered with a border of closed eyelids and stars, his long hair pinned loosely. He holds a small plain pillow of white linen. A faint ring of soft violet light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, half-lowered eyelids, a very quiet look toward the viewer. Low violet light from the left, a dim candle glow on the right. Foreground blur: a soft feather and drifting dust like sleep.

name: 续骨之掌奥斯坦
who: Osten, Palm of Mended Bone, walking among people as a bonesetter at a coach-station: a short old man of about seventy, about 163 cm, sturdy. Cropped greying-white hair, exceptionally large hands with thick knuckles. He recognizes any bone he has touched years later, by feel. Calm and slow. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: white-grey, bone cream, dark brown, linen, iron grey
casual: A bonesetter's clothes: a brown wool jacket closing down the front with wooden buttons, rolled sleeves over a linen shirt, a leather apron, dark trousers, sturdy boots; a bundle of splints and cloth strips at his belt. His large hands hang loose. A calm, slow look.
private: Resting: a worn wool cardigan over a shirt with the sleeves rolled, soft shoes. He kneads his own big knuckles slowly with a quiet smile.
formal: At the healers' rite: a long, fitted dark brown wool coat closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a bone-colored surcoat embroidered with a border of mended lines, a clean linen collar. He holds a plain straight wooden splint across both palms. A faint ring of warm grey light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, a lined and gentle old face, eyes calm. Warm lamp light from the left, grey daylight on the right. Foreground blur: a blurred large hand and a wooden splint.

name: 黑暗里的暖手卢缇亚
who: Lutia, Warm Hand in the Dark, walking among people as a blind guide: a woman of about thirty, about 166 cm, slender. Her eyes are always closed (both eyes). Blue-black hair with a faint blue shine, falling over her shoulders. The hand she holds out is warm, with a layer of fine calluses on the palm. She guides people by the hand to where others are. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: blue-black, warm brown, candle amber, grey wool, cream
casual: A guide's clothes: a long grey wool coat closing down the front with buttons, a dark wool dress, a scarf, boots, a long white walking staff in her left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us) and her right hand held out, open and warm. Both eyes closed, a gentle, steady smile.
private: Resting: an old soft wool cardigan over a linen dress, felt slippers, hair loose. She holds her own warm hands in her lap, both eyes closed in a quiet smile.
formal: Standing at a mine gate: a long, fitted gown of deep slate-blue wool closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a pale surcoat embroidered with a border of small lamps, hair neatly pinned back. She holds out one open hand and a plain white staff in the other. A faint ring of warm amber light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, both eyes closed, a warm hand held out in front toward the viewer. Warm lamp light from the right, a deep dark blue on the left. Foreground blur: the blurred outline of her outstretched hand.

name: 青唇的药师菲洛缇
who: Philotie, the Blue-Lipped Apothecary, walking among people as an apothecary who tastes poisons: a thin woman of about thirty-five, about 167 cm, slight. Short dark-green hair, a faint blue tint on the lips, cool fingertips. She can smell a bowl of soup and say what is in it. Careful, wry, gentle. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: dark green, faint blue-lip, ink black, herb green, glass clear
casual: Rising tower age apothecary: a grey wool robe-coat closing down the front with polished brass buttons, a dark leather apron with small pockets, a plain linen shirt, trousers and boots; a belt of small glass vials. A careful, wry look.
private: Relaxing: an oversized soft wool cardigan over a linen dress, soft shoes, the short green hair messy. She holds a small cup of tea and sniffs it before smiling.
formal: At the apothecaries' guild hall: a long, fitted dark green wool coat closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a grey surcoat embroidered with a border of herbs and a ring, a white linen collar. She holds a clear glass vial of pale liquid. A faint ring of soft green light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, dark-green hair, a faint blue tint on the lips, a wry knowing look at the viewer. Cool green light from the left, a warm lamp glow on the right. Foreground blur: glass vials and a wisp of steam.

name: 鸦羽的女王艾尔缪
who: Elmu, Raven-Feathered Queen, walking among people as a silent woman who sits beside the dying: a woman of about thirty, about 170 cm. Black hair, skin as white as snow, a deep red cloak, eyes that mirror many faces and, looked at long enough, show your own. She says nothing and waits for the person to go; most go quietly. A raven sometimes perches on her shoulder. The same face as her full form, human-sized.

private: Resting by a hearth: the red cloak laid across her knees, a plain black wool dress with sleeves pushed up, soft slippers, black hair loose. She holds a single black feather in both hands, eyes soft.
formal: At a farewell: a long, fitted gown of black wool closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, the deep red cloak fastened at her throat with a silver clasp shaped like a raven's feather, black hair pinned. name: 代痛之身多萝缇
who: Dorothy, Body that Bears the Pain, walking among people as a barefoot young woman of about twenty-five: about 160 cm, slight. Short light flax-colored hair, misty-blue eyes. The backs of her hands are mottled with blue and purple bruises that belong to other people's pain, and she bears a bruise wherever she has taken someone's hurt. She walks quietly and kindly. The same face as her full form, human-sized.
palette: flax, mist blue, bruise purple, undyed linen, pale gold
casual: Barefoot, in plain coarse linen: a long-sleeved undyed linen dress to the shin closing down the front with buttons, a woollen shawl, no shoes, a cloth wrapped around her wrists. Blue and purple bruises show on the backs of her hands. A gentle, patient look.
private: Resting: an old soft linen dress, a knitted shawl, bare feet, hair loose. She holds a cup of warm water in both hands and presses her bruised knuckles against her cheek, a quiet smile.
formal: At a tending rite: a long, fitted gown of white linen closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a pale blue surcoat edged with embroidered small hands, barefoot, her bruised hands showing at the cuffs. She lays her hands open and empty. A faint ring of pale gold light behind her head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, misty-blue eyes looking tenderly at the viewer, a soft smile. Warm light from the left, cool shade on the right. Foreground blur: a blurred bruised hand reaching toward the lens.

name: 立誓者奥尔达
who: Olda, the Oath-Taker, walking among people as a veiled rider of about forty: a man about 183 cm, lean and straight-backed, always in a black veil over the lower half of the face with extremely bright eyes above it. He rides a black horse without a mane. On his hand a stone ring cut with two clasped hands. He appears when an oath is sworn, and listens. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: black veil, bright steel-grey, stone grey, dark brown, silver
casual: A veiled rider's clothes: a long black wool riding coat closing down the front with buttons, a black veil across the lower face, dark gloves, riding boots, a travel-stained grey cloak; a stone ring on his right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us). A grave, bright gaze.
private: Resting: the veil lowered to the chin, the coat off, a plain dark wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, soft boots. He turns the stone ring slowly on his finger, eyes lowered.
formal: Standing as a witness to an oath: a long, fitted black wool coat closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a grey surcoat embroidered with a border of two clasped hands, the black veil across his face, a plain stone-grey cloak. The ring is on his raised hand (on the viewer's left when they face us), the palm open. A faint ring of cold silver light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face half veiled, the eyes extremely bright and looking straight at the viewer. Cold grey light from the left, a faint warm glow on the right. Foreground blur: the stone ring on a raised hand.

name: 认输即止的剑杜兰迦
who: Duranga, the Sword that Stops on Surrender, walking among people as a duelist: a tall, thin man of about thirty-five, about 187 cm. Short dark hair, steady eyes, a long unadorned sword across his back that he never draws in front of others. He looks first at whether a man's hand is steady. Courteous, solemn. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: steel grey, old leather brown, polished black, white linen, dull silver
casual: Early jewel age fashion: polished old leather brigandine over a plain wool shirt, a faded travel cloak with the hood down, dark trousers and boots; a long sheathed sword across his back, never drawn. A solemn, level look.
private: Relaxing: an old dark wool shirt open at the neck, no cloak, soft shoes; the sheathed sword leans out of sight. He rubs a whetstone over nothing, calm.
formal: Before a duel: a long, fitted black wool coat closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a polished leather baldric, a white linen collar. He holds the sheathed sword upright before him with both hands, point down. A faint ring of cold silver light behind his head.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, steady grey eyes looking straight at the viewer, a grave courtesy. Cold light from the left, warm light on the right. Foreground blur: the pommel and hilt of a sword.

name: 举盾者斯卡索
who: Scarso, the Shield-Bearer, walking among people as an old shield-soldier: a heavy, broad old man of about sixty-five, about 192 cm, who seems to grow a hand taller with every step he takes forward. Grey hair cropped short, a square weathered face, steady dark-grey eyes. His left forearm is permanently held a little forward, as if a shield were on it. Gruff and calm. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: iron grey, weathered brown, dull steel, faded blue, bone
casual: Imperial age northern legion look: a grey padded armor jerkin under a heavy grey cloak, grey wool trousers, thick boots, fingerless gloves; no shield in hand. His left forearm is held a little forward. A gruff, steady look.
private: Resting: a worn grey wool coat over a shirt with the sleeves rolled, soft old boots. He sits with the left forearm held a little forward, a quiet half-smile.

art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, a stern old face with calm dark-grey eyes looking at the viewer. Cold steel light from the left, a warm glow on the right. Foreground blur: the rim of a round shield.

name: 断后者雷格纳
who: Regna, the Rear-Guard, walking among people as a plain old soldier: a rangy man of about forty-five, about 182 cm. Short brown hair, a tired steady face, and he always walks a step behind everyone else and sits down facing the way they came. Wears an old cloak and carries a long spear. Quiet and patient. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: faded brown, dull iron, wool grey, dark green, weathered buff leather
casual: An old soldier's clothes: a worn grey-brown cloak over a plain wool tunic, sturdy trousers, boots, a leather belt; a long spear in his right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us), the point up. He stands half-turned, looking back along the way he came. A tired, steady look.
private: Resting: the cloak off and folded under him, a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, the spear resting against his shoulder, soft boots. He sits facing back the way he came, a calm, quiet expression.

art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, turning slightly to look back over his shoulder at the viewer, a quiet and weary look. Dim light from the left, a warm dusk glow on the right. Foreground blur: a spear shaft and the blurred road behind.

name: 鼓与号塔博伦
who: Taboren, Drum and Horn, walking among people as a broad-shouldered army musician: a man of about forty, about 185 cm, with a broad chest. Short curly dark hair, a confident face. palette: drum-hide brown, brass, dark red, charcoal, cream
casual: Rising tower age legion look: a grey-blue wool cloak embroidered with a ring of fire and crossed keys over a plain grey tunic, belted, dark trousers, boots; a brass-bound horn hangs on his chest on a cord. A confident, easy look.

name: 量墙的尺贝里昂
who: Berion, the Wall-Measuring Rule, walking among people as a city mason: a lean man of about fifty-five, about 178 cm, hands covered in lime and rust. Short grey beard, narrow patient eyes, and he looks at the foot of a wall before he looks at anything else. A folding wooden rule hangs at his waist. Methodical, dry. The same face as his full form, human-sized.
palette: lime white, rust brown, stone grey, dark leather, pale wood
